build_byol_experiment: build a BYOL self-supervised representation learning experiment with configurable network and optimizer settings
run_byol_training_step: run a single training step of the BYOL experiment with online and target network updates
create_byol_loss_function: create a loss function combining representation regression loss and classification cross-entropy loss
evaluate_byol_model: evaluate the BYOL model on a dataset subset and return accuracy and loss metrics
initialize_byol_state: initialize the BYOL experiment state with online and target network parameters and optimizer state
